about_the_game:
This is an action RPG that blends urban oddities with hot-blooded street battles.
Two years ago, ChengCheng lost both his parents in a car accident, leaving him and his older sister to depend on each other. She dropped out of high school to take over the family’s long-running drink shop, juggling the pressures of life while raising her younger brother alone.

On the first day of summer vacation, ChengCheng is sent out to deliver a customer’s drink order—an ordinary task that unexpectedly marks the beginning of a series of bizarre events...

Beneath the calm surface of this seemingly ordinary city lie countless mysteries, conflicts, and buried memories.
And this summer… is just getting started.

Features

  • Fast-Paced Real-Time Combat
    Engage in fluid street brawls with light and heavy attacks, combos, and special skills. Unlock new moves as you grow stronger and take on tougher enemies.

  • A Story Full of Twists and Humor
    What begins as a simple drink delivery quickly spirals into absurd events and layered mysteries. Nothing ever goes quite as expected.

  • Open-Ended Exploration and Side Quests
    Dive into a wide range of side stories—from comedic encounters to neighborhood disputes and urban legends. Each quest is self-contained and rewards curiosity.

  • A Vividly Crafted Urban Setting
    Roam streets, plazas, bookstores, salons, and more. Every corner of the city is alive with quirky characters, interactive events, and a surreal sense of the everyday made strange.
